title: Best Yoga Studio Software: Prices Compared (2026)
description: Yoga studio software compared on published prices: Mindbody, WellnessLiving, Arketa, Vagaro, Walla and Mariana Tek for class booking, packs and memberships.
body:
Yoga studios need class booking, class packs and memberships, drop-in payments, and often a client app or marketplace listing. This page is yoga-focused (not the combined dance + yoga roundup) and compares six tools yoga studios actually use, using only each vendor's published pricing and feature pages. We checked those pages on November 4, 2026. Anything a vendor does not publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we do not publish ratings.

{{table:mindbody,wellnessliving,arketa,vagaro,walla,mariana-tek}}

What each tool publishes for yoga studios

  • Mindbody: from $79/mo per location for Starter (North America and Asia), with unlimited users, self-serve booking, branded widgets, a customized website and a listing on the Mindbody consumer app. Accelerate and Ultimate prices are quote only. New clients who find you through the Mindbody app pay a 20% fee on their first purchase, capped at $30 (Mindbody pricing). {{aff:mindbody|Visit Mindbody}}
  • WellnessLiving: Starter $69/mo for one staff member, Business $199/mo with unlimited staff, BusinessPro $349/mo with a white-label client app (annual billing: $62, $179 and $314/mo). Lists classes and appointments booking, Achieve client app, free data migration and onboarding. Card processing rates are not on the pricing page (WellnessLiving pricing). {{aff:wellnessliving|Visit WellnessLiving}}
  • Arketa: Individual $49/mo billed annually for one login and one location, plus a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30. Studio Core, Growth and Suite (unlimited team members, multiple rooms/locations) are quote only. Unlimited on-demand video storage on every plan; month to month unless you pick annual (Arketa pricing). {{aff:arketa|Visit Arketa}}
  • Vagaro: $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99/mo for the first 6 months), plus $10/mo per extra calendar up to seven, then more staff at no extra cost. 30-day free trial and no cancellation fees. Booking through a website widget plus Google, Apple Maps, Instagram and Facebook (Vagaro pricing). {{aff:vagaro|Visit Vagaro}}
  • Walla: from $299/mo per location billed monthly, unlimited users, Book-a-Spot, on-demand video and WallaPredict retention tools included. Walla says it adds no booking fees of its own; optional Walla Offset passes a 3.9% fee to clients at checkout. Pro (branded app, two-way texting) is quote only (Walla pricing). {{aff:walla|Visit Walla}}
  • Mariana Tek: no published prices (intro call required). Custom-branded iOS and Android apps on every plan, kiosk check-in, pick-a-spot floor plans, and Stripe processing with no Mariana Tek markup. Typical onboarding five to eight weeks (Mariana Tek pricing). {{aff:marianatek|Visit Mariana Tek}}

Cost at a glance for yoga studios

Using only published prices: a solo teacher or one-calendar studio pays $30/mo on Vagaro, $49/mo on Arketa Individual (billed annually, plus 3% per transaction), $69/mo on WellnessLiving Starter, or from $79/mo on Mindbody Starter. With several instructors who each need a login or calendar, Vagaro is $70/mo at five calendars (one plus four at $10), WellnessLiving needs Business at $199/mo, Mindbody Starter stays from $79/mo per location with unlimited users, and Walla is $299/mo per location. Arketa Studio plans and Mariana Tek need a quote. Card processing is extra on all of them; only Arketa publishes its platform fee and Stripe rate on the pricing page.

Class packs, drop-ins and memberships

Yoga studios typically sell drop-ins, class packs and unlimited memberships. Mindbody, WellnessLiving, Arketa, Walla and Mariana Tek all describe class packages and memberships on their product or pricing pages. Vagaro lists packages and memberships among the data it can sync for multi-location accounts. Confirm late-cancel fees, intro offers and gift cards in a demo or trial before you switch.

Which yoga studio software to shortlist

For the lowest published monthly price with a small team, Vagaro. For a solo teacher selling classes and on-demand video, Arketa Individual. For published prices with unlimited staff, WellnessLiving Business or Mindbody Starter. For a boutique studio that wants its own branded app instead of a marketplace, Mariana Tek or Walla Pro (both quote-heavy). For more on leaving Mindbody specifically, see Mindbody alternatives for studios and our Mindbody pricing guide.

faq: What is the best yoga studio software?

There is no single best pick from published prices alone. On November 4, 2026 vendor pages: Vagaro starts at $30/mo for one calendar, Arketa Individual at $49/mo billed annually, WellnessLiving Starter at $69/mo (one staff), Mindbody Starter from $79/mo per location with unlimited users, Walla from $299/mo per location, and Mariana Tek is quote only. Choose by staff count, need for a branded app vs marketplace listing, and total fees including card processing.
How much does yoga studio software cost?

Published starting prices checked November 4, 2026: Vagaro $30/mo ($23.99 for the first 6 months) for one bookable calendar, Arketa Individual $49/mo billed annually plus a 3% transaction fee, WellnessLiving Starter $69/mo, Mindbody Starter from $79/mo per location, Walla from $299/mo per location. Mariana Tek does not publish prices (vendor pricing pages).
Does Mindbody work for yoga studios?

Yes. Mindbody lists yoga among fitness and wellness businesses and publishes Starter from $79/mo per location with unlimited users, booking, payments and a Mindbody app listing. New clients who find you through the app carry a 20% fee (capped at $30) on their first purchase (mindbodyonline.com/business/pricing).
What is cheaper than Mindbody for a yoga studio?

On published prices (checked 2026-11-04), Vagaro starts at $30/mo for one calendar, Arketa Individual at $49/mo billed annually (plus 3%), and WellnessLiving Starter at $69/mo for one staff member. For multiple instructors, Mindbody Starter's unlimited users can cost less than WellnessLiving Business ($199/mo) or Vagaro with several calendars.
Which yoga software includes a branded client app?

Mariana Tek includes custom-branded iOS and Android apps on every plan. WellnessLiving includes the Achieve client app on Starter and the white-label Achieve app on BusinessPro. Walla includes a branded studio app on Pro (quote only). Mindbody offers a branded app as an add-on. Arketa lists a custom branded app on Studio Suite (quote only). Confirm current packaging on each vendor's pricing page.
Is this different from the dance and yoga software page?

Yes. /best-dance-studio-software/ covers dance and yoga together with Mindbody, Zen Planner and Gymdesk. This page is yoga-only and compares Mindbody with WellnessLiving, Arketa, Vagaro, Walla and Mariana Tek, which are the tools boutique yoga studios most often shortlist.
